honest_now.name: TruGame
honest_now.job: game engine — pack franchise/sim state, seal the save, run the sim

tools_inside.TRU8: packs who/what residuals (measured NFL save ~1.16 MB → ~144 KB)
tools_inside.Chamber: seals the save (device vault). Seal-as-impl, not the product you buy.

honest_now.alive_league: concept only — one human cell + one NCA coach call not shipped as a product

commandments.name: The name is TruGame
commandments.said: One word, one engine. Not TruGames. Not SPLZ. Not TruChamber. Not 'the Chamber game'.

commandments.name: The job is the engine
commandments.said: TruGame runs and packs a sim. Chamber cloaks JSON. TRU8 compresses. Suite meters jobs. Name the product and the job in the same line.

commandments.name: Building means no buy button
commandments.said: Until there is a TruGame SKU with a unit and a dollar, the only public verb is inquire. mailto:corey@slidphilabs.com?subject=TruGame

commandments.name: Tools are not the product
commandments.said: TRU8 packs. Chamber seals. Those are implementations inside TruGame. Buying TRU8 Year or Chamber Year does not buy TruGame. Do not reuse those SKUs.

commandments.name: No engine leak
commandments.said: Publish outcomes and bytes (ratio, RT, ms). Do not publish coefficients, champion process, Drive dumps, or residual-gov internals.

commandments.name: One workbench
commandments.said: Sports-sims/packages/trugame is the engine tree. sim-nfl is the first sport. Do not start a third repo to look busy.

commandments.name: Proof is a packed save
commandments.said: The residual proof is franchise/state pack → unpack → same world. Quote measured bytes. Do not quote Chamber or TRU8 storefront prices as TruGame proof.

commandments.name: No seat until a TruGame SKU exists
commandments.said: If we sell it later, the line must be: TruGame (engine) · [unit] · $[n]. Not a mashed Chamber+TRU8 seat. Yearly must beat 12× monthly if there is a month.

commandments.name: Public pages stay one honest line
commandments.said: Everywhere: TruGame — game engine (building). Source private. Not Chamber. Not TRU8. corey@. Kill license@ and $99/$1,900 from the TruGame README.

commandments.name: Alive league is not the product yet
commandments.said: Engine chooses city/story-frame. NCA chooses who/what. Human affect writes one cell. Do not sell a living league until one franchise shows one coach call that changed because of one human vector.

first_slice_if_built.nca: one coach that changes the call because of that vector

amen: residual truth · In His name we code
